# Kelvran

> Self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway in Go: POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/embeddings and GET /v1/models in front of Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with virtual keys and budgets, weighted routing and classified failover, a hard-gated three-layer response cache, guardrails, an admin API and OpenTelemetry.

Clients call the gateway at a base URL ending in /v1 with `Authorization: Bearer <virtual key secret>`; the gateway stores only the SHA-256 of the secret (`key_hash`). The admin API is a separate listener (default 127.0.0.1:8081) with admin, operator, viewer and cost-viewer bearer tokens read from environment variables. Configuration is one YAML file; `gateway -config config.yaml -validate` checks it without starting anything; `/healthz` answers 200 when the process is up and `/readyz` reports model readiness when health probing is configured.

Versions follow docs/VERSIONING.md (gateway/vX.Y.Z and evals/vX.Y.Z; a PATCH never breaks, a MINOR may with an UPGRADE.md row). There is no OpenAPI document yet; the data-plane and admin references below are the route tables. Everything linked here is a raw file on the main branch of github.com/kelvran/gateway.

## Docs
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/tutorials/quickstart.md): one deployment, one virtual key, one chat completion in ten minutes
- [First virtual key and budget](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/tutorials/first-virtual-key-and-budget.md): generate and hash a key, give it a budget and a rate limit, see the 429 types
- [First eval suite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/tutorials/first-eval-suite.md): the evals CLI: run, rollout, report
- [Configure Kelvran from a coding agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/configure-from-a-coding-agent.md): what an agent needs, the -validate loop, safety boundaries, recipes
- [Provider credentials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/provider-credentials.md): per-provider credential keys, *_env and hot-reloaded *_file, Bedrock SigV4
- [Virtual keys and budgets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/virtual-keys-and-budgets.md): key_hash, budgets, rate and TPM limits, allowed models, persistence, the admin API
- [Routing and failover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/routing-and-failover.md): deployments sharing a model, weights, fallback chains by error class, health probing
- [Caching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/caching.md): the three cache layers, their keys and defaults, the hard gate, cache erase
- [Streaming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/streaming.md): SSE framing, usage chunk, in-band error frame, what headers streams carry
- [Structured output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/structured-output.md): response_format support per provider
- [Prompt management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/prompt-management.md): prompt_id, labels and versions, the prompt store
- [Admin API and role tiers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/admin-api-rbac.md): the separate admin listener and its token tiers
- [Backup and restore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/backup-and-restore.md): persistence files, the backup route, restore flags
- [Rotate credentials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/rotate-credentials.md): file-backed credentials reload without a restart
- [Upgrade](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/upgrade.md): images, packages, rolling restarts, the stop budget
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/troubleshooting.md): symptom, check, fix
- [OpenAI Python SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/clients/openai-python.md): point the official Python client at the gateway
- [OpenAI Node SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/clients/openai-node.md): point the official Node client at the gateway
- [curl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/clients/curl.md): exact requests for every data-plane route
- [LangChain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/clients/langchain.md): ChatOpenAI pointed at the gateway, errors as LangChain raises them
- [LlamaIndex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/clients/llamaindex.md): OpenAILike with is_chat_model, why the plain OpenAI class does not work
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/how-to/clients/vercel-ai-sdk.md): openai.chat() or the openai-compatible provider, never the Responses API default

## Reference
- [Data-plane API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/data-plane-api.md): every route, header and status code
- [Admin API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/admin-api.md): every admin route with its token tier
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/config.md): every config key with type, default and validation rule
- [kelvran CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/kelvran-cli.md): the companion binary — `kelvran init` writes a priced config and the first key, `kelvran doctor` checks a config against the environment the gateway runs in, `kelvran keys` creates, lists, rotates and deletes virtual keys through the admin API or in the file, `kelvran status` shows what a gateway serves, `kelvran spend` reads spend per key; every verb, flag and exit code
- [Example configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/gateway/config.example.yaml): the commented example every key is documented in
- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/error-codes.md): the OpenAI-shaped error envelope and every type/code pair
- [Metrics and logs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/metrics-and-logs.md): every kelvran.* metric and log event
- [Compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/compatibility.md): which OpenAI request fields are honoured, ignored or extended
- [Release artifacts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/release-artifacts.md): archives, packages, checksums, signatures, how to verify
- [Container image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/container-image.md): tags, platforms, verification, the runtime contract
- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/reference/glossary.md): the terms the other pages use

- [Failure modes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvran/gateway/main/docs/operations/FAILURE-MODES.md): what each dependency's failure does to requests and startup
